name: Veille concurrence L'Oréal (LinkedIn → Google Sheets → OneNote)

blocks.name: Holo — lire LinkedIn
steps: In Google Chrome, open https://www.linkedin.com/company/loreal/about/ (the « À propos » tab of the L'Oréal company page). Read the page only: do not follow, message or click any button other than navigation. Copy every value EXACTLY as written on the page, character by character (accents, plural, spaces).

expect.entreprise: company name as written in the page title
expect.secteur: sector / industry as written in the « Secteur » field
expect.siege: headquarters city as written in the « Siège social » field
expect.taille: company size EXACTLY as written in the « Taille de l'entreprise » field (e.g. « 10 001 employés et plus »), NOT the short summary at the top of the page
expect.abonnes: number of followers as written in the « Abonnés » field (e.g. « 7 M d'abonnés »)
expect.description: the full text of the « Vue d'ensemble » (overview) description, first two sentences max

blocks.name: Holo — lire articles LinkedIn
steps: In Google Chrome, on the L'Oréal LinkedIn company page, click the « Posts » tab, then click the « Articles » filter. Read the titles of the 3 most recent articles. Do not click on any article, do not like, comment or share. Copy the titles EXACTLY as written.

expect.articles: list of the 3 most recent article titles, separated by « | »

blocks.name: Holo — note OneNote
steps: Open Microsoft OneNote, go to the section « Groupe » and open the page « Veille concurrence ». The cursor starts in the page TITLE: type « Veille – {{Holo — lire LinkedIn.entreprise}} (n8n {{today}}) », then press Enter so the cursor is in the BODY. Type this text in the body: « {{Holo — lire LinkedIn.description}} ». Then press Enter twice and type: « Articles récents : {{Holo — lire articles LinkedIn.articles}} ». Check that the title contains only the title, then stop. Do not modify any other page.
